metadata.question: Did Cairns, Queensland receive more rainfall than Cooktown, Queensland (-15.475923, 145.248920) between January 31 and February 4, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) filtered from 2025-01-31 to 2025-02-05 (end-exclusive, i.e., inclusive of Feb 4) over 10 km buffers around Cairns (-16.9186, 145.7781) and Cooktown (-15.475923, 145.248920). If CHIRPS returns 0 images, fall back to ERA5-Land Hourly (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY) summing total_precipitation and converting to mm.
2. Masking strategy: Precipitation products are not affected by clouds; no cloud masking.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null: Check collection size (C1), then valid pixel counts via Reducer.count (C2). If means are null/NaN (C3). Otherwise compare totals: if Cairns > Cooktown then A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  const getInfoAsync = (eeObj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const start = '2025-01-31';
  const end = '2025-02-05'; // end-exclusive; covers Jan 31–Feb 4 inclusive
  const cairnsPt = ee.Geometry.Point([145.7781, -16.9186]);
  const cookPt = ee.Geometry.Point([145.248920, -15.475923]);
  const radius = 10000; // 10 km buffer
  const cairns = cairnsPt.buffer(radius);
  const cook = cookPt.buffer(radius);

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
  let datasetUsed = 'CHIRPS Daily';
  let bandName = 'precipitation'; // CHIRPS band
  let col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')
    .filterDate(start, end);

  let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
  if (size === 0) {
    // Fallback: ERA5-Land Hourly
    datasetUsed = 'ERA5-Land Hourly';
    bandName = 'precipitation'; // we will rename to unify
    let eraCol = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .select('total_precipitation');
    const eraSize = await getInfoAsync(eraCol.size());
    if (eraSize === 0) {
      console.log(`Dates: 2025-01-31 to 2025-02-04 (inclusive)`);
      console.log(`CHIRPS Images: 0`);
      console.log(`ERA5-Land Hourly Images: 0`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location).');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    col = eraCol.map(img => img.multiply(1000).rename('precipitation')); // m -> mm
    size = eraSize;
  }

  // 3. Processing
  const sumImg = col.select(bandName).sum(); // total mm over the period
  const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true});

  const statsCairns = sumImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: reducer,
    geometry: cairns,
    scale: 5000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });
  const statsCook = sumImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: reducer,
    geometry: cook,
    scale: 5000,
    maxPixels: 1e9
  });

  const cInfo = await getInfoAsync(statsCairns);
  const kInfo = await getInfoAsync(statsCook);

  const cMean = cInfo ? cInfo[`${bandName}_mean`] : null; // mm
  const cCount = cInfo ? cInfo[`${bandName}_count`] : 0;
  const kMean = kInfo ? kInfo[`${bandName}_mean`] : null; // mm
  const kCount = kInfo ? kInfo[`${bandName}_count`] : 0;

  // 4. Validation
  console.log(`Dataset: ${datasetUsed}`);
  console.log(`Dates: 2025-01-31 to 2025-02-04 (inclusive)`);
  console.log(`Images: ${size}`);
  if (!cCount || !kCount) {
    console.log(`Cairns Pixels: ${cCount || 0}, Cooktown Pixels: ${kCount || 0}`);
    console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (after processing).');
    console.log('C2');
    return;
  }
  if (cMean === null || kMean === null || isNaN(cMean) || isNaN(kMean)) {
    console.log(`Cairns Rain (mm): ${cMean}, Cooktown Rain (mm): ${kMean}`);
    console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Null/NaN).');
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  // 5. Results and Final Answer
  const cMeanR = Math.round(cMean * 100) / 100;
  const kMeanR = Math.round(kMean * 100) / 100;
  const diff = Math.round((cMean - kMean) * 100) / 100;

  console.log(`AOI radius: 10 km; scale: 5000 m`);
  console.log(`Cairns Rain (mm): ${cMeanR}, Pixels: ${cCount}`);
  console.log(`Cooktown Rain (mm): ${kMeanR}, Pixels: ${kCount}`);
  console.log(`Difference (Cairns - Cooktown) mm: ${diff}`);

  if (cMean > kMean) {
    console.log('A: Yes');
  } else {
    console.log('B: No');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
